categories.main_business_segments: New China Life Insurance Company Ltd. primarily operates in life insurance, including traditional insurance, participating insurance, universal insurance, and unit-linked insurance. It also has significant asset management and investment management businesses through its subsidiaries. The company offers a comprehensive service ecosystem covering medical care, healthcare, old-age care, wealth management, legal, tax, commerce, education, leisure, and culture services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and large models to empower its operations, including digital services and digital risk control. It employs actuarial methods and IFRS 17 accounting standards for insurance contract measurement. Investment management uses a value-oriented, long-term approach with diversified portfolios and risk management techniques including asset-liability matching and stress testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: New China Life serves over 31 million individual customers and 78 thousand institutional customers across China. Its products cater to individuals seeking life insurance, health insurance, accident insurance, and wealth management solutions, as well as enterprises requiring group insurance and pension finance. The company also targets high-net-worth clients with specialized services and supports national strategies including rural revitalization and inclusive finance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide in the People's Republic of China, with a headquarters in Beijing and a place of business in Hong Kong. It has established marketing and service networks covering all provinces and major cities in China, including east, west, north, south, and central regions. Its asset management subsidiary also operates in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: New China Life operates primarily downstream in the insurance value chain, providing insurance products and services directly to customers. It also operates midstream through asset management and investment activities, managing insurance funds and investments to support its insurance liabilities and business growth.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-quality, customer-centric development, emphasizing reforms in product innovation, sales team professionalization, and service ecosystem expansion. It prioritizes national strategies including technology finance, green finance, inclusive finance, pension finance, and digital finance. Digital transformation and fintech investment are key R&D directions, integrating advanced technologies into underwriting, claims, and customer service.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through premiums from life insurance products, including first-year, regular, single, and renewal premiums. Additional income comes from investment returns on insurance funds, asset management fees, and other service-related fees. The company also earns income from reinsurance arrangements and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: New China Life is a leading life insurance company in China, listed on both the Shanghai and Hong Kong Stock Exchanges. It competes with other major Chinese insurers such as China Life Insurance Company Limited. The company is recognized for its strong brand, financial strength ratings (A2 by Moody's, A by Fitch), and inclusion in top insurance brand rankings, positioning it as a top-tier insurer in the Chinese market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, New China Life reported gross written premiums of RMB170.5 billion, total assets of RMB1.69 trillion, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB26.2 billion, all reaching record highs. The company showed strong growth with a 2.8% increase in premiums and a 201.1% increase in net profit year-on-year. Its embedded value was RMB258.4 billion, with a new business value of RMB6.25 billion, reflecting robust profitability and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a comprehensive, whole-life-cycle insurance and financial service offering, integrating protection, wealth planning, healthcare, and old-age care. Its multi-level product portfolio, digital empowerment, and service ecosystem brands (e.g., Xinhua Zun, Xinhua An) differentiate it by addressing diverse customer needs with high-quality, inclusive, and innovative solutions. The company also highlights its role in supporting national strategies and sustainable development as a unique value proposition.
